children.value: > Fact From Story Jawan is a reminder of what blockbuster movies can be — fun and exciting, but with plenty on its mind.
> Fact From Story Jawan combines some of the year’s best action, romance, and dance numbers within a compelling revenge story with a strong “power to the people” message.
> > Fact From Story The key to Jawan’s joyful success, though, is Shah Rukh Khan.
> > > Fact From Story One of the biggest movie stars in the world, he has returned to blockbuster cinema after a brief hiatus with Pathaan and this movie.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Talented actors improve movies.
> > Fact From Story Jawan is a genre-bending, crowd-pleasing spectacle that rests on the reliably charismatic talents of star Shah Rukh Khan.
> > > Fact From Story Jawan is many things, but the cleanest description of the premise is “Charlie’s Angels meets Robin Hood.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge "Charlie's Angels meets Robin Hood" is a fun and exciting premise for a movie.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Charismatic actors make movies more fun.
> Commonsense Knowledge Movies that are fun and have a good message are good movies.
